subject: HSM shift-log retention exception & sampling plan
messages:
From: Lighthouse Systems <security@lighthouse.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Neal Rivera <neal.rivera@finservices.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary retention exception for HSM shift logs

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our due diligence for the SIG review, our security team has requested a short exception to Redwood's default HSM shift-log retention window. Specifically, the auditor is asking that we retain operator shift logs and related wrap/unwrap events for 180 days (instead of the usual 90) while they complete a residual evidence sweep for our SOC 2 + SIG batch.}

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 
- Provide a documented retention-exception process and an access-controlled storage location for the extended logs,
- Supply a sample set of anonymized HSM shift logs (redacted PII) and a KMS rotation ledger extract, and
- Share a proposed sampling plan that limits data exposure but satisfies auditor sampling.

We appreciate any constraints you have (cost, SLA, legal). If there are alternative artifacts that satisfy the auditor (for example, a notarized summary of wrap/unwrap counts + signed operator shift manifests) that would also work.

Attached: retention-exception-request-form.pdf (filled by customer)

Best,
Lighthouse Security Team
[Attachment: retention-exception-request-form.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lighthouse Systems <security@lighthouse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention exception for HSM shift logs

Hi Neal / Lighthouse team,

Thanks — we can support a timeboxed retention exception with controls to limit exposure. High level proposal below; full artifacts and delivery options after you confirm preferred method (secure SFTP vs. time-limited GCS signed URLs).

Proposal (summary):
- Scope: HSM operator shift logs + wrap/unwrap event audit trail + KMS rotation ledger for the tenant(s) tied to your account HS-4821.
- Retention window: extend to 180 days for the requested artifacts only; normal retention applies to other telemetry.
- Access controls: artifacts encrypted at rest (AES-256), stored in a customer-segregated bucket with RBAC limited to our Compliance team and a single auditor principal you nominate. All retrievals audited and signed.
- Sampling plan: weekly sampling of operator shifts (1 in 4 shifts) plus full wrap/unwrap aggregate counts per day. If auditor needs more, we can expand to 2 in 4 shifts.
- Rotation and integrity: include KMS rotation ledger extract showing wrap/unwrap timestamps, key version IDs, and signed rotation events. Ledger will not contain private key material — only operational metadata.
- Timeline: initial sample + documentation within 3 business days after your confirmation; full 180-day exception execution within 24 hours thereafter.

Notes / constraints:
- We cannot export raw private key material from HSMs. Shift logs will be redacted to remove tenant identifiers beyond what your auditor needs.
- Extended retention incurs storage and access costs; we'll provide a short cost estimate in the follow-up.

Marissa, Ben — can you prep the sample HSM shift log (redacted) and a ledger skeleton? I'll coordinate signatures and delivery method with Neal.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales (Security & Compliance Liaisons)
Redwood Inference

Markus / Neal,

I attached a small redacted sample and a ledger skeleton to illustrate what we'll provide. Sample contents and notes below.

Attachments: 
- hsm-shiftlog-sample.txt (redacted) — contains operator id hashes, UTC timestamps, shift-checksum, and action codes; tenant names replaced with tenant_####.
- kms-rotation-ledger-skeleton.csv — includes columns: timestamp_utc, key_id, version, action (rotate/wrap/unwrap), operator_hash, signature_present

Sample delivery options: secure SFTP (audit trail + IP allowlist) or GCS signed URLs (time-limited). If you prefer SFTP, provide the destination username and the public key for the account; we will place files under /incoming/HS-4821/audit/.

Security notes (for auditors):
- At-rest: files will be encrypted using customer-specific encryption keys; S3/GCS server-side encryption + object-level ACLs.
- In-transit: SFTP/TLS with enforced client certificates.
- Rotation evidence: ledger will show rotation events and key version progression; we will include checksums and a signed manifest of the exported sample.

Estimated work effort: 2 engineer-days to finalize redaction and sampling automation, then ongoing weekly sampling per the proposed cadence. Storage estimate: ~1GB/month for 180-day retention at current sampling rates.

Please confirm delivery mechanism and the exact auditor principal (email) we should grant.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — that looks good and covers the auditor questions. We prefer secure SFTP delivery (auditor requires IP allowlist). Please use auditor account aud.jmartinez@lighthouse-audits.com as the principal for read-only access.

Two quick asks before you deliver the initial sample: 
1) Include a short README.txt describing the redaction rules (what was removed and why).
2) Provide the signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) for every file you place on SFTP.

If you can get the initial sample + README + manifest onto SFTP by end of day Friday (5 Dec), the auditor will accept that as evidence to open their sampling window. Also, please include a cost estimate for the 180-day retention so our procurement team can approve the exception.
